summary: Phase 3 dark mode, testimonials, and image refresh testing completed. Theme toggle works correctly on desktop and mobile (in mobile menu), persists across navigation. Testimonials section renders with 6 cards and review summary (4.9/5, 1,284 reviews). All images load successfully. Multi-traveler application flow functional. No regressions detected.
